subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should OpenClaw land this broader combined PR as the canonical fix, or prefer the Tavily-only PR and split the agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot repair into separate work?
rationale: Both PRs provide credible guarded Tavily fixes, but only this branch includes the additional agent runtime repair; choosing the canonical branch and acceptable scope is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical patch correction.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix
options.body: Refresh the branch and exact-head type gate, merge this PR, then close or retarget https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 as overlapping work.

options.title: Split the runtime repair
options.body: Land the narrower Tavily-only PR and request a separate focused PR for the shared agent Tool Search runtime-config helper and tests.

options.title: Pause for scope reduction
options.body: Keep both PRs open temporarily while an owner decides whether the agent runtime change belongs in the same landing unit.

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and exact-head type gate, merge this PR, then close or retarget https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 as overlapping work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned, consolidated the current branch, and has the strongest current evidence of ownership across both affected surfaces.
